shape: someone does a small thing for you and never mentions it; name that as love

slides.text: she refilled the empty coffee jar at night, never said a word, [[that’s love]]

caption:
tiny habits outlast grand gestures
she knows your coffee needs before you even think about them
send this to the mum who always has a fresh cup waiting for you

#mother #mumquotes #momquotes
